steps.text: Confirm event date, seasonality, setup window, operating hours, teardown timing, and peak booking pressure.

steps.text: Map the rink footprint, skate area, check-in flow, guest circulation, emergency access, and nearby amenities.

content.title: Event and holiday activation questions
content.subtitle: Early planning helps match the rink experience to the event format.

items.question: Can portable rink rentals work for one-day events?
items.answer: The right fit depends on setup timing, venue access, rental scope, staffing, and teardown windows. Share the schedule when requesting options.

items.question: What event details should we provide first?
items.answer: Start with the date, venue address, indoor or outdoor placement, guest count, available space, event hours, and any activation goals.

items.question: Can the rink be branded for sponsors or companies?
items.answer: Branding may be possible depending on the rental package and add-ons. Ask about signage, decor, lighting, and sponsor visibility during quote planning.

items.question: How should guest flow be planned?
items.answer: Plan space for entry, exit, skate support, viewing, seating, lines, staff access, and safe circulation around the rink.

items.question: What affects holiday availability?
items.answer: Peak dates, local travel, setup duration, rental length, add-ons, and venue requirements can all affect availability and timing.
